note: Inventory of infra-requirements.dsh.md §11 (change list) and §12 (removal list). infra/nix/fleet.nix refuses a manifest that names a package which does not exist or omits a change id, so this file cannot drift away from the tree.

changes.title: tmux pane management: placement records, the real-time channel and the interrupt path
tmux SubagentProvider: pane, NDJSON frames, fresh|resident sessions
cross-machine tmux gateway (TCP to tmux unix socket, dynamic port)
worker launch template: resident sdk process, stty, credential env passthrough
session/prompt source field: distinguish a leader's instruction from a human message
turn-stopping git checkpoint hook plus asynchronous push retry queue
per-turn session archiver writing per-machine refs
worktree management: N candidates as N worktrees and branches
durable performance ledger keyed by member
machine registry and MachineContext (hostid, alias, nix system)
TaskSpec with acceptance as a first-class, machine-checkable field
ConfigGeneration record: flake URI, revision, lock hash, store path
interrupt channel: signal or kill the process in a pane
Nix-only sandbox profile: /nix/store read-only, workspace, tmp, no package managers, no network
nix develop -c shell provider: every command runs inside the flake environment
Nix mandate prompt section at order 700, written together with the workspace AGENTS.md
acceptance templates carrying nix flake check / nix build / nix develop -c
